The app receives a login, creates a session, and saves it so later requests can find it. Separately, a form gives the user immediate success feedback while the server work finishes. These are two stories, so I will not make the user walk through every changed line.

The story has two chapters: the session travels from creation into storage, then the form changes what the user sees during submission. I’ll keep each causal path intact and start with the session because the form does not depend on it.
